**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`cel-go`), wrapped by the in-repo `filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go:25` (`Engine`, `NewEngine` `:26`; schema in `internal/filter/schema.go`, parsing in `parser.go`, IR in `ir.go`).

Mechanism: the API validates/normalizes the filter (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go`) and passes filter strings down in `store.FindMemo.Filters`; each dialect driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` then `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.Dialect*, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:54-58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:65-69`), which compiles CEL to a dialect-agnostic condition tree and then renders per-dialect SQL fragments + bind args in `internal/filter/render.go` (dialect switches throughout, e.g. `:231-237`, `:502-508`, `:786-790`).

```

attachment     (store/memo.go:149-157 → Store.DeleteAttachment, store/attachment.go:148)
memo           (the row itself, plus comment memos deleted by the handler — store/memo.go:158; server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:574,579)

                _pragma=foreign_keys(0) at store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53, so the cascade

```
`reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545`) but are **not** deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the Vite build output is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by an Echo static-file handler with SPA fallback to `index.html`. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:41` (`FrontendService.Serve`), `:107-118`; invoked from `server/server.go:70` (`frontend.NewFrontendService(profile, store).Serve(ctx, echoServer)`). Build output lands in `server/router/frontend/dist/`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner — started at server/server.go:159-168; RunOnce immediately, then a
                   time.Ticker every 12 hours (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26-39)
webhook async dispatch workers — 4 goroutines started by package init(), driven by a
                   bounded channel queue (internal/webhook/webhook.go:38-53); not started
                   by Server.startBackgroundRunners
```
Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler` — a full cron-expression scheduler (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`) with **no production importers**; the only references are its own `example_test.go:10` and `integration_test.go:13`. Also `server/runner/memopayload` is *not* run as a background runner — its `RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`) is never called; only the helper `RebuildMemoPayload` is used inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.**
```
interceptor: web/src/connect.ts:146 (authInterceptor), installed on the transport at
             web/src/connect.ts:173-178
tokens: short-lived JWT access token (in-memory + localStorage "memos_access_token",
             web/src/auth-state.ts:3-7, cross-tab sync via BroadcastChannel :13-45) sent as
             "Authorization: Bearer <token>" (web/src/connect.ts:97); refresh token as an
             HttpOnly cookie "memos_refresh" (never touched by JS; requests use
             credentials:"include", web/src/connect.ts:59-64) exchanged via AuthService.RefreshToken
             on preflight expiry or a 401 retry (web/src/connect.ts:73-79, 146-170).
             Personal access tokens are also accepted as Bearer tokens by the backend.
backend validation package: server/auth (Authenticator — server/auth/authenticator.go:41
             AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2, :61 AuthenticateByRefreshToken, :102 AuthenticateByPAT;
             JWT parse/generate in server/auth/token.go), invoked by the Connect
             AuthInterceptor at server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213-227 together
             with the Authorizer in server/router/api/v1/authz.go
```

**q30.**
```
memo created:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15  (called memo_service.go:157)
memo updated:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:20  (called memo_update_helpers.go:67)
memo deleted:          APIV1Service.DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook        — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:25  (called memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created:  APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:30  (called memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three converge on `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four then converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:182`), whose worker pool calls `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:119`) for actual HTTP delivery. Activity types: `memos.memo.created`, `memos.memo.updated`, `memos.memo.deleted`, `memos.memo.comment.created`.
